comparison.objective: Seat a close-fitting rigid box lid squarely over a product without wedging or damage; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2264 tests level multi-edge alignment and controlled telescoping insertion; the candidate tests driver/wrench seating, threaded regulation, counterholding, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2264 grades lid height, centring, squareness, engagement, box stability, and release; the candidate grades opening angle, nut retention, cycle repeatability, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Close-fit lid placement and threaded stop calibration test different manipulation abilities and outcomes.
